summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen and Jim Coyne gave a sparring exhibition in Rochester, New York, and would be joined by English champion Jem Mace, newly arrived in New York, before heading to St. Louis.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE MISSOURI REPUBLICAN, ST. LOUIS, SUNDAY MORNING, SEPTEMBER 19, 1869; the page shown carries the full front-page masthead, so 'pg 2' in details may be wrong

facts.fact: Allen and Jim Coyne gave a sparring exhibition in Rochester, New York
Jem Mace, champion of England, arrived in New York and was to join Allen and Coyne, with the party expected in St. Louis the following Saturday
